blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 Host Japan won its third straight Asian Games women’s football gold on Friday, edging North Korea on penalties after a 2-2 draw in a dramatic final. Yuzuho Shiokoshi scored the decisive penalty as Japan, which reached the final without conceding a goal, won 5-3 in the shootout to claim the title for the fourth time. North Korea changed its goalkeeper in the final minute of extra time but it was not enough to give them its first gold since 2014. The hosts looked in full control when Mami Ueno […]...
